High-speed FPV drone tracking shot, strictly rear view. A young woman with a ponytail in a white t-shirt and denim shorts is speeding on a self-propelled jet-surfboard. The rear-integrated blue glowing turbines are vibrating, kicking up intense water spray. The camera is locked to her back as she blasts into a narrow, craggy canyon. No tow rope, hands free for balance. Cinematic lighting, Unreal Engine 5 render.

Continuing the high-speed chase from behind. The river transitions into neon bioluminescent water. The blue glow from the surfboard’s engines blends with the glowing water. Prismatic reflections dance on her white t-shirt. The drone maintains a constant distance from her back as she navigates the glowing canyon. Strictly rear view, motion blur on the canyon walls.

The girl leans her body deeply into a sharp river bend, her arms extended for balance (no handle). The camera tilts in sync with her. The water-jet propulsion nozzles under the board eject a massive, pressurized fan of water. The engine’s hum is visible through heat haze effects. Locked-on rear perspective, high-velocity movement through the ancient mossy cliffs.

She accelerates towards the horizon, becoming a dark silhouette against the massive sun. The camera accelerates with her until the screen is engulfed in pure white light. High-energy finale, seamless end.
